B1.title: Approved Document B: Fire safety, Volume 1: Dwellings
B1.edition: 2019 edition incorporating 2020, 2022, 2025 and 2026 amendments, collated with 2029 amendments
B1.licence: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Approved Document B © Crown copyright.
B1.note: Pages marked “Effective until 1 September 2029” apply now. Pages marked “2029 amendment” take effect on 2 September 2029.
B1.amendments: 2019 edition incorporating the 2020, 2022, 2025 and 2026 amendments. The 2029 amendments are shown alongside.
B1.inForce: The 2026 amendments added more than one common stair in blocks of flats with a storey 18m or more in height, and provisions for evacuation lifts.
B1.transition: The current text (2019 edition with 2020, 2022, 2025 and 2026 amendments) still applies after 2 September 2029 where a building notice, initial notice or full plans application went in before that date and the work is sufficiently progressed before it, or within six months of it.
B1.notYet: The 2029 amendments take effect on 2 September 2029. They remove national classes for fire resistance. Pages marked "From 2 Sep 2029" are not yet in force.
